target_claim: For every vector space over an infinite field, every vector v satisfying v = -v must satisfy v = 0.
source_quote:
We have {{hypothesis}} that $\GF$ is [[Definition:Infinite Set|infinite]].

By [[Characteristic of Division Ring is Zero or Prime]]:
:$\Char \GF = 0$
so $-2 \cdot 1_\GF \ne 0$.

Thus from [[Vector Product is Zero only if Factor is Zero]], $\mathbf v = \mathbf 0$.
